description: Java class defining the RuleChain entity in the Thingsboard project, including properties, constructors, and methods related to rule chain configuration and metadata.

classes.name: RuleChain
classes.description: Represents a rule chain with properties such as tenant ID, name, type, configuration, and metadata, used within the Thingsboard rule engine.

methods.name: RuleChain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a RuleChain with a specific ID.

methods.name: RuleChain
methods.description: Copy constructor that clones an existing RuleChain.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the rule chain.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the rule chain.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the rule chain.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON configuration of the rule chain.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the JSON configuration for the rule chain.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Determines if the rule chain is the default core rule chain.
